name: Create registry
context:
POST /docker-registry
Create registry
Required: body (body)
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Delete registry
context:
DELETE /docker-registry/{id}
Delete registry
Required: id (path) — ID of the docker registry
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Get registry
context:
GET /docker-registry/{id}
Get registry
Required: id (path) — ID of the docker registry
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Get temporary registry access for pushing snapshots
description: Get temporary registry access for pushing snapshots GET /docker-registry/registry-push-access
context:
GET /docker-registry/registry-push-access
Get temporary registry access for pushing snapshots
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID; regionId (query) — ID of the region where the snapshot will be available (defaults to organization default region)

name: List registries
context:
GET /docker-registry
List registries
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID

name: Update registry
context:
PATCH /docker-registry/{id}
Update registry
Required: id (path) — ID of the docker registry; body (body)
Optional: X-Daytona-Organization-ID (header) — Use with JWT to specify the organization ID
